name: common
description: Shared mindset skills required by the alegomes topology plugins. Ships mental-model, active-listener, zero-micromanagement, conversational-response, till-done, autonomous-mode, green-or-revert, and acceptance-completeness. Agents: completion-auditor (independent last-mile acceptance gate). Commands: /autonomous-start, /autonomous-resume, /debrief, /recap, /branch, /return, and the per-session worktree lifecycle (/worktree-start, /worktree-merge, /worktree-list, /worktree-discard, /worktree-name) for parallel `claude` windows on one repo. Launcher: bin/ccw — drop-in for `claude` that auto-isolates a session into its own git worktree only when another live session already occupies the tree. Hooks: autonomous-checkpoint (PostToolUse on Task), session-log (UserPromptSubmit), session-subject (UserPromptSubmit — experimental lexical subject-shift detection), session-activity (PostToolUse Edit|Write|MultiEdit — records touched dirs), session-registry (SessionStart/SessionEnd — live-session registry, overlap warning, worktree auto-clean + unmerged reminder, WIP-autosave), mark-build-stale + capture-build-result + gate-advance (the green-or-revert state machine), lead-no-worktree (PreToolUse on Task — blocks worktree-isolated leads), acceptance-gate (PreToolUse on transitionJiraIssue — blocks In-Review while the acceptance audit is incomplete). Helpers: _wtlib.py + session-launch.py + session-worktrees.py (worktree engine), expertise-append.py (flock-serialized append+prune for the shared mental-model.yaml files).
